## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (patch)
- [ ] New feature (minor)
- [ ] Breaking change (major)
- [ ] Docs / examples / internal only (no changeset needed)

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build` pass locally
- [ ] Coverage thresholds hold (`pnpm coverage`)
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) — required for user-facing changes
- [ ] Docs updated if the public API changed
